title: List the district names and average credit card withdrawal amounts for acco
question: List the district names and average credit card withdrawal amounts for accounts that have monthly statement issuance (frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'), are located in regions with average salary above 8000, made at least one credit card withdrawal (operation = 'VYBER KARTOU') between 1996 and 1998, and had a negative balance after any such withdrawal. Only include districts where the total number of such withdrawals exceeds 2.

prediction.sql:
SELECT d.XCL_018 AS district_name, AVG(t.XCL_051) AS avg_withdrawal
FROM district d
INNER JOIN account a ON d.XCL_017 = a.XCL_002
INNER JOIN trans t ON a.XCL_001 = t.XCL_047
WHERE a.XCL_003 = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND t.XCL_050 = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', t.XCL_048) BETWEEN '1996' AND '1998'
  AND t.XCL_052 < 0
  AND d.XCL_027 > 8000
GROUP BY d.XCL_017, d.XCL_018
HAVING COUNT(t.XCL_046) > 2
